topic: Finding the new location traffic forecast page
summary_markdown:
The conversation centered on locating a specific internal tool or page designed to predict traffic for new physical locations. The initial discussion covered whether the resource was in analytics, Google Drive, or Figma.

[p1] described the functionality: selecting a location and data source to generate predicted traffic, suggesting it might have been an interface simulation (e.g., 'testing for new location' or 'traffic forecast').

Ultimately, [me] located the page and shared the direct link: `https://analytics.allunite.com/inventory/test-location`.
decisions: The specific URL for testing new location traffic predictions was identified.
